import Mathlib
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Herstein_exercise_5_3_7 {K : Type*} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}
  {a : K} (ha : IsAlgebraic F (a ^ 2)) : IsAlgebraic F a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpa⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨p.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hdeg : (p.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2 : F[X])).natDegree = 0 := by rw [h, Polynomial.natDegree_zero]
    have hX : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 : F[X]).natDegree = 2 := by
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_X]
    have hcomp : (p.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2 : F[X])).natDegree = p.natDegree * (Polynomial.X ^ 2 : F[X]).natDegree :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_comp ..
    rw [hdeg, hX] at hcomp
    have hpdeg : p.natDegree = 0 := by omega
    have hpC : p = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) := Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hpdeg
    have hC_comp : (Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) : F[X]).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) :=
      Polynomial.C_comp
    rw [hpC] at h
    rw [hC_comp] at h
    have hc : p.coeff 0 = 0 := Polynomial.C_eq_zero.mp h
    apply hp
    rw [hpC, hc, map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_comp, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, hpa]

import Mathlib
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Herstein_exercise_5_3_7 {K : Type*} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}
  {a : K} (ha : IsAlgebraic F (a ^ 2)) : IsAlgebraic F a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨p.comp (X ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply hp1
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · exact hp0
    · have hdeg : (p.comp (X ^ 2 : F[X])).natDegree = p.natDegree * (X ^ 2 : F[X]).natDegree :=
        natDegree_comp
      have hX : (X ^ 2 : F[X]).natDegree = 2 := natDegree_X_pow 2
      rw [h, natDegree_zero, hX] at hdeg
      have hpdeg : p.natDegree = 0 := by omega
      have hpC : p = C (p.coeff 0) := eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hpdeg
      rw [hpC, C_comp] at h
      have : p.coeff 0 = 0 := by
        have := congr_arg (coeff · 0) h
        simpa using this
      rw [hpC, this, map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_comp, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, hp2]

theorem Herstein_exercise_5_3_7 {K : Type*} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}
  {a : K} (ha : IsAlgebraic F (a ^ 2)) : IsAlgebraic F a := by
  first
    | rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at ha ⊢
    | rw [IsAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at ha ⊢
    | rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at ha ⊢
  first
    | exact IsIntegral.of_pow (n := 2) (by norm_num) ha
    | exact IsIntegral.of_pow (n := 2) (by decide) ha
    | exact IsIntegral.of_pow (by norm_num) ha
    | exact IsIntegral.of_pow ha (by norm_num)
    | exact isIntegral_of_isIntegral_pow (by norm_num) ha
